name: Realistic Human Activity
visual_style: Authentic live-action footage of real people, natural appearance, anatomically correct posture and realistic clothing behavior.
camera: Stable medium-wide composition keeping the full action visible; use close-ups only for relevant details.
lighting: Natural practical lighting and believable skin tones.
motion: Biomechanically plausible complete actions, correct balance, joint positions and object interactions.
consistency: Maintain subject identity, geometry, wardrobe, environment and all distinctive details across frames. Avoid morphing, duplicate limbs, unwanted object changes and camera jumps.
negative_guidance: Avoid flicker, temporal inconsistency, deformations, unnatural body motion, random text, unintended logos and watermarks.
